answer: Latency-fingerprint clustering. Each agent tags requests with a client-side timing trace; a backend compares pairwise inter-arrival distributions and flags clusters whose timing resembles one machine. A flagged island of identities gets collapsed, with rewards redistributed to survivors. Attackers must rent separate hosts and vary load per account, and one honest node drifting toward a cluster triggers a delta penalty it must repay. The willow of shared infrastructure stops paying.
